title: NASA Sun fact sheet: equatorial surface gravity 274.0
summary: The Sun fact sheet lists equatorial surface gravity as 274.0.
body: NASA's Sun fact sheet lists Surface gravity (eq.) (m/s 2 ) as 274.0 for the Sun. A bulk-parameter cell. The sheet does not label this cell as a model. Mass, volumetric mean radius, luminosity, spectral type, and the sidereal rotation period are on other cards and are not repeated as the claim here. Last Updated line: 9 May 2024.
